description: Is this NDC still active? Checks a US National Drug Code against RxNorm and reports whether it is active, obsolete, alien or unknown, which product (RxCUI and name) it maps to, the source vocabularies that list it, and its month-by-month mapping history, from the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxNav. Useful for pharmacy, billing and claims work on old or unfamiliar codes. It covers US NDCs only and reflects RxNorm's records, which can lag FDA listing changes; it does not give price, packaging or supply. (cost: 1 credit)

ndc.description: string, required, an 11-digit NDC (e.g. "00071015523") or a hyphenated 10-digit NDC (4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1)

name: ndc_status
